issue.description:
Found by the unknown-field interchange conformance work (beadrs-5f2da62c).

Repro: bead sync import-only --input issues.jsonl --merge into a fresh workspace (the bare interchange shape carries no store identity), then sync flush-only. The published merge receipt has source_store_uuid "" because create_merge_receipt stamps staging.store_uuid, which the bare-shape stager leaves empty. Every generation that workspace publishes from then on carries the receipt, and bead restore of any of them bails in validate_forensic_receipts with 'Integrity error: Provenance receipt merge-... has invalid required fields' (checkpoint.rs requires a non-empty source_store_uuid). The workspace becomes unrestorable from every post-merge generation — silent at merge time, fatal at recovery.

Fix direction: stamp a real source identity at merge time (local workspace uuid, or a deterministic placeholder derived from the input hash) and/or teach validate_forensic_receipts the bare-interchange merge shape narrowly. Either way the fix should land with a round-trip test: merge-import a bare issues.jsonl, flush, bead restore must succeed.
issue.title: Merge receipts from bare issues.jsonl imports carry an empty source_store_uuid, so every later checkpoint restore fails integrity validation
